title: Jumbled Sentence 95
subject: History
caption: Flowchart showing extraction and correct ordering of sentence parts S‑Q‑R‑P for Jumbled Sentence 95.
altText: The diagram starts with a jumbled sentence node that branches to four part nodes labeled S, Q, R, and P. All parts flow into an arrange order node, which leads to the correct sentence node and then to a verification node. A subgraph illustrates the required sequence S → Q → R → P, highlighted with a green style.
